hints: Lines through the origin have equation $y = mx$.
walkthrough:
Every line through the origin has zero intercept; tangency then fixes its gradient.
Substitute $y = mx$ into the circle equation $(x - 5)^2 + y^2 = 9$:
$$(x - 5)^2 + (mx)^2 = 9$$
$$x^2 - 10x + 25 + m^2x^2 = 9$$
$$(1 + m^2)x^2 - 10x + 16 = 0$$

Set the discriminant to zero for tangency:
$$\Delta = (-10)^2 - 4(1 + m^2)(16) = 0$$
$$100 - 64 - 64m^2 = 0$$
$$64m^2 = 36 \implies m^2 = \dfrac{36}{64} = \dfrac{9}{16} \implies m = \pm \dfrac{3}{4}$$
